en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.205 - It was reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), that

Maymunah used to say:
‘The Prophet would instruct me, when I was menstruating, to wrap myself with a cloth (izar) and then lie down with him in bed.'
